barbell_runner_strategy.authorized_by: user 8/4: 'lock win early = my scale-out to make sure I'm profit on the day for sure, but let some continue for 1000% growth with a strict trailing stop'
barbell_runner_strategy.applies_to: options-watchlist runners; requires >=2 contracts (prefer 2x-small sizing so scale-out is possible)
barbell_runner_strategy.principle: ALWAYS BE REALIZING: bank tranches of profit on the way UP (not just trail paper gains), so growth is continuously locked as realized $ while a final piece keeps running. Maximize overall gains, but every leg realizes profit.
barbell_runner_strategy.leg_A_day_lock: SCALE OUT ~half at the first target (+30-50%) to BANK guaranteed profit -> secures the DAY green for sure (target.scale_out_frac). Once realized day P&L is green and covers this trade's cost, the remainder is HOUSE MONEY.
barbell_runner_strategy.leg_B_moonshot: Runner remainder rides for 1000%+ (no cap) with CONTINUOUS REALIZATION - scale out a slice at each milestone to keep banking realized profit: sell ~1/3 of the remainder at +100%, ~1/3 at +300%, hold the last piece toward +500-1000%. The final piece rides a STRICT trailing stop (NOT the loose day trail): give-back peak_frac 0.20 (lock 80% of peak) armed at +100%, PLUS floor ratchets +100%->lock +50%, +200%->+120%, +300%->+200%, +500%->+380%, +1000%->+800%. Marketable exits. Never-red automatic (leg A covered cost).
barbell_runner_strategy.why: Barbell = guaranteed green day (leg A) + a continuously-realized, protected moonshot (leg B). You always lock/realize growth on the way up AND keep a piece for the 10x; the strict trail protects the big number without paperhanding it. Single-contract positions can't scale - they use never-red + give-back (or size to 2-3 lots to enable tranche realization).
barbell_runner_strategy.engine: BUILT v4.5: reporter.size_order() fills the per-trade cap with up to 3 lots (same risk envelope, enables scale-out); reporter.materialize_exit_rules() auto-stamps leg-A scale-out + leg-B strict giveback (0.20) on any >=2-lot entry (single lot -> never-red runner), index scalps get the VWAP trail. Wired into the entry action (qty + exit_rules). Small live BP (~$200) usually resolves to 1 lot until cheaper contracts / more BP.
